chunks: It is We indeed who bring back the dead to life, and write down what they send ahead (of their deeds), and traces that they leave behind. We keep an account of all things in a lucid register.

key_terms.نُحْيِي الْمَوْتَى: We bring back the dead to life

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about how God records human deeds and their traces?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'Imam al-Mubin' is often interpreted as the Quran itself or the Prophet and Imams, serving as the clear guide through which divine knowledge is preserved. This verse underscores the continuity of divine recording from individual actions to their enduring 'athar' (effects), highlighting the meticulous nature of God's accounting on the Day of Judgment.
